intro.h2: Countertops chosen at your pace and installed with care
paragraphs: SKL STONEX GRANITE supplies and installs granite countertops in Tampa, FL, for kitchens and bathrooms. One customer had both kitchen and bathroom counters done with us and says everything was great from the first communication, and that Steve helped coordinate a time to view counters and never once rushed them.

Steve was present during the install to make sure everything was perfect, and the installers did a fantastic job too, by that customer's account. Another homeowner got several estimates before choosing us and has no regrets, saying Steve is easy to reach, calls you back, takes precautions with your home and leaves a clean job site.

items.name: Kitchen countertops
items.blurb: Kitchens come up in seven of our Google reviews. The kitchen shown here has white stone counters with soft gray veining along the perimeter and a long island with an undermount stainless sink, paired with white shaker uppers and a stained wood island base.

items.name: Bathroom vanity tops
items.blurb: A new vanity top can lift a whole bathroom. Riley S. had bathroom counters done along with the kitchen, so both rooms got the same attention from selection to install. Bring your vanity measurements, and we will talk through stone and sink options with you.

about.text: SKL STONEX GRANITE is a granite supplier serving homeowners in Tampa, Florida, and Steve Lopez is the person customers deal with. Our reviews describe him coordinating times to view counters, never rushing a decision, staying on site during installation, returning calls and keeping the job site clean. Kitchens and countertops are the topics that come up most, and our work covers bathroom counters as well. If you are comparing estimates for new counters, call Steve Monday through Friday between 8 AM and 6 PM and talk through your project.

items.text: Had my kitchen and bathroom counters done by SKL. Steve Lopez was our guy there.  Everything was great from our first communication. Steve helped coordinate a time to view counters and never once rushed us. He was present during the install to make sure everything was perfect. The installers also did a fantastic job. items.name: R M.
items.text: Steve from SKL Stonex is great to work with. He is very easy to get in contact with, he calls you back, he is honest, does great work, take precautions of your home, and clean job site. I had a few estimates done for my project and I’m glad I went with SKL. No regrets..

service_area.text: SKL STONEX GRANITE works with homeowners in Tampa, Florida. If your home is outside the city and you want to know whether we can take on your kitchen or bathroom counters, call (813) 833-9435 on a weekday between 8 AM and 6 PM. Tell Steve where the house is and which counters you are replacing, and he will let you know.

items.q: Do you do bathroom counters as well as kitchens?
items.a: Yes. One customer had both kitchen and bathroom counters done by SKL, with Steve coordinating a time to view counters and staying present during the installation. Call us with the number of counters and rough sizes, and we will talk through the options for each room.

items.q: Can I see the stone before it is installed?
items.a: Yes. Steve coordinates a time for you to view counters before installation, and a customer says he never once rushed them. Seeing the actual stone helps you judge its color, pattern and movement in a way that a small sample cannot.

items.q: Will someone from SKL be there during the install?
items.a: For one of our customers, Steve was present during the installation to make sure everything was perfect, and that customer says the installers did a fantastic job and everyone was nice and professional. Ask about this when we set your install date.

items.q: I am getting several estimates. Why choose SKL?
items.a: Getting more than one estimate is smart. One homeowner did exactly that before choosing us, is glad to have gone with SKL and has no regrets, pointing to Steve's honesty, the precautions taken in the home, a clean job site and calls that get returned.

Call (813) 833-9435 Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM. You can also email sklstonex@gmail.com with your kitchen or bathroom measurements and a few photos of your cabinets, and Steve will follow up with you about your project.

final_cta.text: Call Steve to talk about stone for your kitchen or bathroom.
